integrity: The move definitions were implemented from the cited primary source, and the independent replay reproduces the source's published 3186-state and 18/3168 layer totals before computing the new orbit and quotient-graph data.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns only the move-state set reachable from gamma through words with at most eleven petals; it makes no claim about the unrestricted graph or paths through thirteen or more petals.
title: Dihedral quotient of the gamma petal trap is a 144-leaf star
